thread:
emma: Postmortem follow-up for Borealis (dedicated). Short RC recap: intermittent VPC peering flaps + conntrack table exhaustion on customer's on-prem firewall + a routing replication race that allowed stale routes to persist. Created JIRA RED-872 to track remediation items. Posting owners and next steps.

raj: I'll own peering resilience. Tasks: enable BFD with 300ms intervals, add debounce (hold-time 30s) before session tear-down, and apply BGP dampening policy to avoid rapid withdraw storms. ETA: Tue EOD.

kim: I'll take the conntrack mitigation and runbook updates for on-prem guidance. Plan: document expected conntrack thresholds, recommend conntrack tuning, and add a fallback NAT gateway config for high-connection bursts. Need to sync with account team for a maintenance window.

ivan: Routing replication bug is mine. Root cause: race between replication writer and route aging job. Patch in branch `fix/replicate-atomicize` that adds a per-route generation token and an idempotent apply. Will need a small DB column `route_gen` and a controlled rolling restart on the dedicated pool. Requesting review + canary.

natalie: I'll add observability and alerts. New metrics: `vpc_peering_bgp_flap_rate`, `conntrack_utilization_pct`. Alert rules: flap_rate > 2/minute for 15m -> Sev3; conntrack_utilization > 85% -> page oncall. Dashboard panels consolidated under `Customer Isolation / Borealis`.

infra-bot: Channel #incident-borealis-1726123456 created. JIRA RED-872 linked. Canary runbook stub attached.

emma: Owner map: peering -> @raj, conntrack/runbook -> @kim, routing replication -> @ivan, observability -> @natalie. Add weekly post-rollout checks for 6 weeks.

raj: Test plan excerpt: stage to dedicated-staging, run `peering-flapper --interval 5s --duration 10m`, validate BFD session flaps suppressed and no session teardown for transient blips. Will upload logs to RED-872.

kim: On conntrack testing: will run a synthetic connection flood from staging to emulate customer burst, validate conntrack entries and NAT behavior. Adding sample commands to runbook: `sudo conntrack -S` and `watch -n1 'sudo conntrack -L | wc -l'`. Propose maintenance window 2026-04-01 03:00-05:00 UTC.

ivan: Implementation note: migration script `add_route_gen.sql` included in branch. Rolling restart plan: canary on a single dedicated node, monitor route convergence and replication lag. Proposed canary Thu 02:00-03:00 UTC.

natalie: Dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/borealis-isolation. Created alert playbook with runbook links.

emma: Timeline & deliverables recap: raj (peering PR + tests), ivan (replication PR + migration + canary), kim (runbook + conntrack tests + customer window), natalie (alerts + dashboard). Target finish: next Fri COB. If blockers, flag here.

raj: ack. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/networking/pull/421

ivan: ack and requested reviewers tagged.

kim: ack. Sent draft customer comms to accounts; holding until canary window confirmed.

natalie: ack. Setting up weekly check-ins in calendar for 6 weeks post-rollout.

emma: Ops checklist addition: add an "isolation triage" template to incident deck capturing: packet captures, conntrack dumps, BGP state, route table snapshots. Example commands: `sudo tcpdump -i eth0 host <cust-ip> and port 179 -w /tmp/bgp.pcap` and `sudo conntrack -L > /tmp/conntrack.dump`.

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: reviewer ping for PRs in 48h.

emma: We'll review progress in the incident retro on Mon 2026-03-30. Keep RED-872 updated with PR links, test results, and customer communications. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
